data.value: Colour contours and portrait matching. Confirms 45 of 67 champions on the test corpus with no false confirmations, about 40 ms per frame.

data.name: Settings.Recognizer.OwnModel.Hint
data.value: Our own neural model. Confirms 64 of 67 on the test corpus with one or two false confirmations, about 8 ms per frame, and holds a moving champion on every frame. Knows every champion of the current patch.

data.name: Settings.Recognizer.Description
data.value: How TempoCue reads the minimap. The own model recognises more champions at a quarter of the frame cost; the built-in pipeline stays as a fallback. The choice applies after a restart.

data.name: Settings.Recognizer.RestartNotice
data.value: The choice applies after TempoCue restarts.

data.name: Settings.Recognition.Threads.Description
data.value: How many parts of the map TempoCue compares at once. More threads mean a faster frame and earlier notifications, but less processor left for the game. Recognition accuracy is unaffected — only speed changes.

data.name: Settings.Recognition.Threads.Hint.Automatic
data.value: A quarter of the processors, never fewer than two. Notifications arrive on time and the game keeps most of the machine. Start here and change it only for a reason.

data.name: Settings.Recognition.Threads.Hint.Frugal
data.value: Easy on the processor, but a frame takes long to analyse. Suits weak machines; appearance notifications will arrive later.

data.name: Settings.Recognition.Threads.Hint.Balanced
data.value: Room on both sides: notifications keep up and the game keeps most of the processor.

data.name: Settings.Recognition.Threads.Hint.Fast
data.value: Notifications arrive sooner, but TempoCue takes a noticeable share of the processor. Pick this when analysis cannot keep up with the limit.

data.name: Settings.Recognition.Threads.Hint.Maximum
data.value: Every processor. It will not get faster, and the game may suffer — pick this only if it visibly helps.

data.name: Settings.Recognition.Threads.RiskNotice
data.value: A single thread is not enough: analysing a frame takes about as long as the appearance confirmation window, so the chain of observations keeps breaking. Brief appearances will be lost.

data.name: Settings.Recognition.Threads.Guidance
data.value: Check the diagnostics card above: if the actual analysis FPS is below the limit, add threads; if it matches, there is nothing to add.

data.name: Settings.Recognition.Threads.RestartNotice
data.value: The choice applies after TempoCue restarts.
